items.title_en: ‘Racism In India?’: Foreigner Questions Paying More At Dilli Haat, Social Media Pushes Back
items.title_zh: “印度存在种族主义？”：外国人质疑在 Dilli Haat 支付更多费用，社交媒体予以反击
items.summary_en: A foreign tourist questioned why visitors from other countries pay more at Delhi’s Dilli Haat, leading users to debate whether different entry fees are fair in such places for all.
items.summary_zh: 一名外国游客质疑为什么其他国家的游客在德里的 Dilli Haat 支付更高的费用，这导致用户争论在这些地方不同的入场费对所有人来说是否公平。

items.title_en: Chello Meme Gifts Samay Raina Traditional Attire In Heartwarming Reunion After Viral Roast: ‘Arunachal Love
items.title_zh: Chello Meme 赠送 Samay Raina 传统服装，在病毒式烘烤后温馨的团聚中：“阿鲁纳恰尔之爱”
items.summary_en: In the video that she shared, Chello Meme and Samay Raina were seen laughing during their meeting, with Chello even gifting him some traditional gifts from Arunachal
items.summary_zh: 在她分享的视频中，Chello Meme 和 Samay Raina 在会面时大笑，Chello 甚至赠送了他一些阿鲁纳恰尔邦的传统礼物
